pages: Bram, a boy of ten, short black hair, a bright yellow wool jersey, sleeves turned back, stands at a workbench in the low room behind the net shed. Middle distance: the shortwave set with its lid off, the round black bakelite dial, the thin white needle, valves in a row. Background: a low window and black sea. Grey daylight.

Senn, forty-nine, grey hair plaited down her back, in a red knitted vest, standing at a workbench in a net shed with one hand flat on the wooden case of a shortwave set, its lid off, looking down at it. Middle distance: a round black bakelite dial with a thin white needle, a row of glass valves, a cloth. Background: a low window with black sea behind it, and a lit lamp on the bench. Warm lamplight on her hands and the brass of the set, everything else in cold blue night.

Bram, a boy of ten, short black hair, a bright yellow wool jersey, sleeves turned back, turns the round black bakelite dial with one fingertip, the thin white needle sliding across the scale. Middle distance: a screwdriver and a coil of bare copper wire on the bench. Background: the low window, black sea. Grey daylight.

Bram, a boy of ten, short black hair, a bright yellow wool jersey, sleeves turned back, holds a coil of bare copper wire in both hands at the foot of a mast. Middle distance: an aerial wire running up the mast, a broom against the net shed wall. Background: grey sea and wind-flattened grass. Blown spring daylight.

Bram, a boy of ten, short black hair, a bright yellow wool jersey, sleeves turned back, leans over the bench with one hand on the set's case, his face near the dial. Middle distance: the round black bakelite dial, the thin white needle at the end of the band. Background: a leather case, black sea. Evening light.

Bram, a boy of ten, short black hair, a bright yellow wool jersey, sleeves turned back, stands at the end of the bench with both hands on its edge. Middle distance: the dark shortwave set, the round black bakelite dial and thin white needle, a broom. Background: a low window, black sea. One lamp overhead.

Senn, forty-nine, grey hair plaited down her back, a red knitted vest, stands with a broom brush laid flat on the boards at her feet, one hand still on the handle. Middle distance: the shortwave set, the round black bakelite dial and thin white needle. Background: the low window going dark, black sea. Lamplight on the bench.

Senn, forty-nine, grey hair plaited down her back, a red knitted vest, writes on a sheet with a pencil at the bench beside the shortwave set. Middle distance: the round black bakelite dial and thin white needle, the leather case open, an open ledger. Background: the low window, black sea, rain running on the glass. Lamplight.

Senn, forty-nine, grey hair plaited down her back, a red knitted vest, sits on a stool at the bench with her hands on her knees, her face turned to the set. Middle distance: the round black bakelite dial and thin white needle, the volume knob at nothing, the closed leather case. Background: the low window, black sea, rain. Steady lamplight.

Bram, a boy of ten, short black hair, a bright yellow wool jersey, sleeves turned back, copies a printed sheet into a ledger with a pencil, holding the page flat with his other hand. Middle distance: the shortwave set, the round black bakelite dial and thin white needle, the leather case. Background: the low window, grey sea. Flat morning light.

Bram, a boy of ten, short black hair, a bright yellow wool jersey, sleeves turned back, sits at the bench with a pencil and an open ledger. Middle distance: the shortwave set, the round black bakelite dial, the thin white needle resting at the dead end of the band. Background: the low window, black sea. Evening light.

Iris, a girl of eleven with auburn hair in two plaits, in a long green coat to her knees, seen from behind, standing at a wooden fence post with her left hand flat on the brass lid of a rain gauge. Middle distance: the wet meadow, a wire fence, her boots in the mud. Background: a mill wheel, low grey morning light. One bright green shape against flat wet grey.

A cylindrical metal rain gauge is strapped to a wooden post in a field above the mill, brass funnel open, a float wire behind scratched glass. Middle distance: a wire fence and a narrow path. Background: a mill wheel turning slow, a school porch far below. Flat grey morning light.

Iris, a girl of eleven, auburn hair in two plaits, a long green coat to her knees, dark boots, writes on a tally board in the school porch with chalk. Middle distance: the open porch door. Background: the field above the mill, the gauge on its post. Cold morning light.

Iris, a girl of eleven, auburn hair in two plaits, a long green coat to her knees, dark boots, stands on the top step of the school porch with one hand flat on the tally board. Middle distance: the porch rail, the open door. Background: the wet path down to the mill, flattened grass. Grey morning light in the doorway.

Iris, a girl of eleven, auburn hair in two plaits, a long green coat to her knees, dark boots, stands beside the tally board with one hand on the chalk-written figure. Middle distance: the porch rail, a bucket set down on the boards. Background: the field, the gauge on its post, the mill wheel. Flat white daylight.

Iris, a girl of eleven, auburn hair in two plaits, a long green coat to her knees, dark boots, stands on the school porch with the chalk still in her hand. Middle distance: the tally board and its rows of figures, the porch rail. Background: the gauge on its post above the mill, the wire fence. Cold morning light.

Iris, a girl of eleven, auburn hair in two plaits, a long green coat to her knees, dark boots, stands at the gauge with one fingertip against the scratched glass. Middle distance: the brass funnel, the float wire, the needle. Background: the wire fence, flattened wet grass, the mill wheel. Grey daylight on the wet field.

Iris, a girl of eleven, auburn hair in two plaits, a long green coat to her knees, dark boots, sets the chalk on the shelf under the tally board with both hands. Middle distance: the board and its chalked figures, the open porch door. Background: the wet path down to the mill. Steady daylight through the doorway.

A stone trough in the mill yard stands half full of brown water, six wooden buckets set along its edge in one long row. Middle distance: the mill wheel still, the sluice boards nailed across the well mouth. Background: the field above, the gauge on its post, low cloud. Flat overcast light.

Iris, a girl of eleven, auburn hair in two plaits, a long green coat to her knees, dark boots, comes up the path from school carrying a full bucket in both hands. Middle distance: bare footprints crossing the wet grass to the porch steps. Background: the tally board in the porch, the gauge on its post. Low evening light.

A rope hangs slack down the open well shaft at the mill, coiled wet on the stones, a bucket of grey sand tipped beside it. Middle distance: the mill leat running thin over its stones. Background: the field above, the gauge on its post, its brass cup still torn in the ditch. Flat grey light.

Iris, a girl of eleven, auburn hair in two plaits, a long green coat to her knees, dark boots, stands at the gauge post with the torn brass cup hung on its hook, hand on the closed lid. Middle distance: the scratched glass and the float wire. Background: the wire fence, the school porch. Seven o'clock light.

Tove Bakke, a broad-shouldered man of fifty with a full grey beard, a white baker's jacket with the sleeves turned up over a dark apron, slides the last loaf onto the long bare wooden bread board. Middle distance: a bread knife, a rack of empty trays. Background: the brick oven banked warm. Low oven light.

Tove Bakke, a broad-shouldered man of fifty with a full grey beard, a white baker's jacket with the sleeves turned up over a dark apron, slides the last loaf onto the long bare wooden bread board. Middle distance: a bread knife, an empty tray rack. Background: the brick oven banked. Oven light.

Tove Bakke, a broad-shouldered man of fifty with a full grey beard, a white baker's jacket with the sleeves turned up over a dark apron, stands in the bakery doorway with one hand on the frame. Middle distance: the bread board inside, a rack of trays. Background: the chapel wall, the road. Flat morning light.

Tove Bakke, a broad-shouldered man of fifty with a full grey beard, a white baker's jacket with the sleeves turned up over a dark apron, stands at the open door with his hand on the frame. Middle distance: four loaves on the long bare wooden bread board. Background: the open flour bin, the brick oven. Cold grey morning light.

Tove Bakke, a broad-shouldered man of fifty with a full grey beard, a white baker's jacket with the sleeves turned up over a dark apron, lays two loaves on the long bare wooden bread board, his hands flat on either side of them. Middle distance: the bread knife, the rack of trays. Background: the open door, snow outside. Flat daylight.

Tove Bakke, a broad-shouldered man of fifty with a full grey beard, a white baker's jacket with the sleeves turned up over a dark apron, stands at the board with both hands flat on its bare wood. Middle distance: an emptied tray rack, a scraped patch of flour. Background: the small square window, snow on the sill. Quiet grey light.

Tove Bakke, a broad-shouldered man of fifty with a full grey beard, a white baker's jacket with the sleeves turned up over a dark apron, stands at the board with both hands flat on its bare wood. Middle distance: an empty tray rack, scraped flour. Background: the small square window, snow on the sill. Grey light.

Sindre stands at the table with one thumb pressed on the edge of the long bare wooden bread board. Middle distance: a single loaf standing on the board, the rack of trays behind. Background: the brick oven banked warm, the small square window with snow on its sill. Grey daylight.

Sindre lifts his thumb off the edge of the long bare wooden bread board and stands square to the table. Middle distance: the loaf left standing on the board, flour dust in the grain of the wood. Background: the open bakery door, the road past the chapel corner. Flat winter light.

Sindre lifts his thumb off the edge of the long bare wooden bread board. Middle distance: the loaf left standing on the board, flour dust in the grain of the wood. Background: the open bakery door, the road past the chapel corner. Flat winter light.

Tove Bakke, a broad-shouldered man of fifty with a full grey beard, a white baker's jacket with the sleeves turned up over a dark apron, sits at a plain kitchen table with a heap of crusts on a plate. Middle distance: an empty chair, a bare cloth. Background: a window, a bare wall. Cold evening light.

Tove Bakke, a broad-shouldered man of fifty with a full grey beard, a white baker's jacket with the sleeves turned up over a dark apron, stands inside the bakery door, both hands at his sides, empty doorway. Middle distance: one loaf in the bin, the long bare wooden bread board. Background: the chapel corner, snow past it. Four o'clock light.
